    Careers
    at Sunbit.

    We are the leading point-of-sale lending solution for the things that matter most. Auto care, dental care, eye care, vet care, and more. Sunbit was included on the 2022 Inc. 5000 list. The financial technology company has also been named as a Most Loved Workplace®, Best Point of Sale Company, A N.A. Deloitte Technology Fast 500 company, and as a Top Fintech Startup by CB Insights.

    Important Note: Be aware of phishing attempts. All official Sunbit hiring communication comes only from an @Sunbit email or LinkedIn, and we will never request sensitive information or payments.

    Get to know the team.

    Play

    Our Core Values

    Serve others before self
    We exist to serve customers and merchants. Take care of the needs of our customers, merchants, and each other. Treat others well, be humble and kind.
    Own the impact
    We do the hard work to make an impact. What matters is how and what we deliver.
    Connect genuinely
    We engage and build relationships. We show up, listen and relate. We know that people and real connections matter.
    Act fast
    We roll up our sleeves and act. We get things done.
    Include always
    Our business is built on including everyone we can. Everyone is important and valuable. We provide opportunities to people from all walks of life. We don’t leave anyone behind.
    Innovate for good
    We use cutting-edge technology to improve people's lives. We simplify things that are complex. We have the courage to ask questions.

    Get to know Sunbit.

    We’re a team of experts from different backgrounds, professions, and cultures, coming together to build products and services that change the world.

    Our culture is focused on serving the needs of others, adapting to change, and learning from our peers along the way.
